root_cause.text: Integer overflow in 16-bit arithmetic when computing the total TVLV allocation length for a global TT response, leading to an undersized heap buffer and a subsequent heap buffer overflow during tt_change filling.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that "batadv_tt_prepare_tvlv_global_data() builds the allocation length for a global TT response in 16-bit temporaries. When a remote originator advertises a large enough global TT, the TT payload length plus the VLAN header offset can exceed 65535 and wrap before kmalloc(). The full-table response path still uses the original TT payload length when it fills tt_change, so the wrapped allocation is too small and batadv_tt_prepare_tvlv_global_data() writes past the end of the heap object." The patch adds overflow checks: `if (change_offset > U16_MAX || *tt_len > U16_MAX - change_offset)` to reject such oversized responses.
